_doc: Documented, ACCEPTED schema divergences. db:check prints every nullability/FK finding but only fails on findings NOT listed here. Each entry is a decision, not a hiding place: give a real reason and a ticket, and work it off. A green db:check means 'no drift except these known items', never 'schema matches the models'. Match key = `<kind>:<schema>.<table>.<column-or-fk>`. Added by TASK-024; Group-A onDelete mismatches resolved by aligning models to live in BUG-025.

allow.reason: permanent — cross-schema reference, no in-DB FK possible. user_id holds a platform/auth user id (auth.users); ca.users is vestigial/empty (0 rows), so an in-DB FK to ca.users would reject every insert and a cross-schema FK to auth.users would violate per-schema isolation.

FLAGGED for live migration (do NOT downgrade the model). Model intends CASCADE, live is NO ACTION. The model's CASCADE is correct — a crl_counter is a strict dependent of its issuing CA certificate (RFC 5280 monotonic per-issuer counter) and should die with it. Recommend a live migration to bring the FK to ON DELETE CASCADE rather than weakening the model to NO ACTION. Kept allowlisted until that migration lands.
BY DESIGN: entity_id is a polymorphic reference (targets multiple entity types); no single FK is possible.
